place.name: Fugging, Upper Austria
place.description: Fugging (German: [ˈfʊɡɪŋ] ), spelt Fucking until 2021, is an Austrian village in the municipality of Tarsdorf, located in the Innviertel region of western Upper Austria. It is 33 km (21 mi) north of Salzburg and 4 km (2.5 mi) east of the Inn river, which forms part of the German border.
